custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Make sure the Service Manager role is at its default permissions: reset it to its template, so earlier edits do not change the result.
  • Sign in as a staff member with the default Service Manager role at the test location.
  • Have an active, tracked part, part A, with 2 on hand.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154782-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154782-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • Settings: click the box at the top right, then Settings in its menu. The left menu then lists Staff, Roles & Permissions, Bin Locations and Categories, and Inventory under IMPORTS.
  • To create a custom role: Settings, then Roles & Permissions in the left menu, then Create Custom Role; in Choose a template click Skip; type the Role Name; switch on Parts Department, then tick the boxes the setup names on its three rows, Part sales, Part Library and Inventory, and Vendor and order management (each has View, Create & Edit and Delete); See Financial Data is under Cross-Cutting Toggles; then click Create. (The setup above writes these boxes as, for example, Part Library & Inventory — View, which is the View box on the Part Library and Inventory row.)
  • User B: the QA site's sign-in screen offers only Admin and Tech, so user B is the shared Tech sign-in given role B for this test. Signed in as Admin: Settings, then Staff in the left menu; click Search, type tech@shopview.com, click the edit icon at the end of Tech ShopView's row, pick role B under Role and click Save & Close. Then, in the second (private) window, choose Tech on the sign-in screen. When the test is finished, set Tech ShopView's Role back to Technician the same way, because other testers use that sign-in.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu lists Cycle count, Deactivate parts and Export.

Step 2:

  • The menu closes.

Step 3:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 4:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.
  • The red Delete Part button shows at the left of the footer.
  • Part Status (Active, Inactive) can be picked, and the Track quantities and cost of goods switch can be clicked: the status and tracking controls show exactly where Delete Part shows.

Step 5:

  • The window closes without saving.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions)

  • S8-R14: “The controls this spec gates on the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission show to exactly the users who see Delete on the part dialog today. By default those are Admin, Service Manager and Parts Manager.”
  • Key Decisions: “Access does not change. Retiring a part, bringing it back and changing its tracking use the same access ShopView applies to deleting an inventory part today. The controls show to exactly the users who see Delete on the part dialog today. The system accepts exactly the users it accepts a delete from today, on every route. No user gains or loses access on release day (Story 8).”
  • Story 8, context note: “Context note (S8-R14, S8-R15): this spec does not change who can do what. Several role settings carry the right to delete inventory parts behind the scenes, and that stays exactly as it is today.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
